test_title: PYST 43: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 30 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment without changing its meaning in the given sentence.

Entrepreneurial __endeavours drive economic growth__ and innovation, empowering individuals to bring their ideas to fruition.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "ventures contribute to economic flourishing". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"endeavours"** refers to attempts or efforts made to achieve a goal. (प्रयास) • **Example:** His endeavours to build a successful startup paid off after years of hard work. • The word **"ventures"** refers to initiatives or projects undertaken, often involving risks, particularly in a business context. (उद्यम) • **Example:** The new business ventures in renewable energy have greatly contributed to environmental sustainability. • The context tells us that entrepreneurial ventures are closely related to economic flourishing, as they promote innovation and growth in various industries. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: pursuits manipulates economic success** (प्रयास आर्थिक सफलता को हेरफेर करते हैं): "Manipulates" implies deceit or control in a negative way, which doesn't fit the original sentence. • **Example:** The company manipulates data to mislead investors. • **Option 3: actions spur economic recession** (कार्य आर्थिक मंदी को प्रेरित करते हैं): "Economic recession" refers to a period of economic decline, which is opposite to the idea of growth and innovation mentioned in the original sentence. • **Example:** Poor policy decisions can spur economic recession in developing nations. • **Option 4: projects discourage economic prosperity** (परियोजनाएँ आर्थिक समृद्धि को हतोत्साहित करती हैं): "Discourage economic prosperity" contradicts the positive tone of the sentence, which emphasizes empowerment and growth. • **Example:** High taxes can discourage economic prosperity by limiting business growth. 3b:Tb81, The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Cassocks**.
